## Problem
What user problem should Cribble solve?

## Proposed direction
Describe the smallest useful version of the feature.

## Product fit
How does this preserve Cribble's local-first, reader-first, and
preview-before-mutation principles?

## Alternatives considered
What should Cribble not do here?

## Contribution intent
- [ ] I am only proposing the idea.
- [ ] I would like to implement it after maintainer agreement.

Feature and UX pull requests should be discussed and accepted before coding.
